description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Aththidiya North, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District (7842)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing parcels of land, cadastral maps, servitude rights, and encumbrances. It contains multiple entries documenting land title amendments for specific parcels in various locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
